subject: How to make a Submit button that does not affect all forms in my Shiny app?

messages.subject: How to make a Submit button that does not affect all forms in my Shiny app?
parts:
I want to implement a Submit button together with some numeric inputs etc. Once the submit button is clicked, I upload this data to a database. But when I do this, the rest of my reactive app only updates when this button is clicked. How do I separate this? I only want the submit button to work on my current fluidPage, not the rest. 

I hope it makes sense and that you can help :)

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: How to make a Submit button that does not affect all forms in my Shiny app?
parts:
I think you probably want to use actionButton instead.

There's a demo here:
  http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/actionbutton-demo.html

And for a more in-depth understanding of action buttons (and reactivity in general), check out he articles in the "Reactive Programming" section here:
  http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/
